notes: Phase layers are ADDITIVE loops at the parent cue's tempo/bars (-25 LUFS target): they play over the base cue, they do not replace it. Combined base+layer loudness/true-peak is measured from real bytes and recorded per layer.

Each MD7 layer adds only what its base and the earlier layers do not already do: thang_long intensity adds the two-beat city drum pulse the busy street arrangement withholds (no drums at all in the base) plus a low pluck echo on melody-free bars; tran_son intensity completes the two-beat drum pulse, fills the bass on beats 1/3 and adds the offbeat shaker the bell-led form withholds; bach_uyen intensity adds the deep current (bar-line drum, bass fill, offbeat shaker, motif echo, final-bar D5 bell), low-passed at 850 Hz like its parent; rift_finale intensity adds the resolve pulse (drums on bars 0-14, bass fill, offbeat shaker, motif echo) and leaves bar 15 alone, where the base already lands its only full close; quiet_discovery intensity adds the depth the silence withholds (first bass the cue ever carries, late shaker in the second half, motif echo) and deliberately carries NO drums, so the pulse never fights the cue's identity.

Adoption is a presentation-adapter decision (Codex): the MD7 files are delivered in parallel under ClientGodot/assets/audio/composed/layers/ and do NOT replace the ported PackV1 files, their cue bindings, or the checkpoint-26/30/MD1/MD2/MD3/MD4/MD5/MD6 cues.

No ear audition has been done; loudness/true-peak are measured from real bytes. Loop seams are recorded per looping cue in the delivery manifest: wrapJump after a disclosed 0.25 s end-landing loop construction, wrapJumpRaw before it.
